sources.snippet: AgentWeave is a domain-agnostic framework for discovering, validating, selecting, and orchestrating heterogeneous AI agents across cloud, marketplaces, enterprise, and edge environments. A2A is the interoperability layer; AgentWeave adds requirement-aware discovery, evidence-backed capability validation, contextual trust, policy, team optimization, collaboration, semantic result verification ...

sources.title: AgentWeave
sources.snippet: AgentWeave records parent sessions, delegated sessions, LLM calls, tool calls, model usage, token totals, cache behavior, and cost in one OpenTelemetry-compatible span contract.

sources.title: AgentWeave: Routing Before Reasoning for Efficient Function Calling in ...
sources.snippet: ToolACE [7] constructs large, verified function-calling training corpora and demonstrates that carefully synthesized data can produce strong function-call performance. These approaches improve the model; AgentWeave instead holds the model fixed and changes only the candidate functions visible before inference.

sources.title: [2608.23078] AgentWeave: Routing Before Reasoning for Efficient ...
sources.snippet: We introduce AgentWeave, a deterministic pre-inference routing layer that constructs a bounded model-visible action space using eligibility, requirement, capability, and routing signals.

sources.snippet: AgentWeave reduces the tools or agents visible to a model before inference while keeping scope policy, authorization, provenance, recovery, and execution explicit.
